events.event_hazard: Cyclone Aila with storm surge and flooding
key_impacts: Washed away 243,191 houses and left 370,587 houses partially damaged in Bangladesh.
In Dakshin Bedkashi union, killed 33 people.
Washed away 3,520 houses and partially damaged 1,800 houses in Dakshin Bedkashi union.
Storm surge overtopped and breached the coastal embankment in six places, damaging 20.55 km (of 27.37 km).
Inundated almost the entire Dakshin Bedkashi union.
missing_information: Total fatalities in Bangladesh not provided.
Full list of affected districts not provided.

events.event_hazard: Prolonged tidal inundation from storm-surge-induced embankment breaches
key_impacts: Villages were inundated twice a day by tidal water until rehabilitation of coastal polders in 2013.
Delayed housing recovery along with recovery of other sectors.
missing_information: Number of affected households not provided.
Spatial extent of twice-daily inundation within the union not specified.

key_impacts: Bangladesh government prioritized housing recovery after cyclone Sidr.
Post-Sidr housing recovery failed to improve safety from cyclone hazard (per cited studies).
Prompted a trend toward in-situ housing reconstruction with limited owner participation.
missing_information: Damage and casualty figures not provided.

key_impacts: After the 1991 cyclone, international humanitarian organizations and development partners first became involved in housing-related humanitarian aid in Bangladesh.
